notes.general_comments:
1572 candidates took this 30 question multiple choice examination and the mean score was 21.4, almost
identical to the mean score of 21.3 from the previous year.
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 8, 9, 11, 13, 14, 16, 17, 18, 20,
26, 28 and 29. These questions were answered correctly by 80% or more of the candidates. They covered
different parts of the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
